rootCauseOfTheDisagreement: buildTier1Payload (nodeFacetBakeTier1Cli.ts) implements a SECOND, independent, owner-gated situs-address join (resolveAddressLandUse) that legitimately recovers a real land-use code for a gate-blocked county from the certified 2026-08-26 Hays CAD drop -- distinct from, and never re-enabling, the disabled prop_id join. draw.attrs.landUse reads this recovered value directly (baseFacts.landUse) and is correct. The land-use-fact atom that the brief section trusts (evaluated 2026-08-12, BEFORE the certified drop existed) has no equivalent recovery logic and always reports join-hold for any FIPS in its disabled set. r1BriefCompose.ts's buildR1Brief (2026-09-07 D2 fix) made the brief trust the atom unconditionally whenever its state is not 'refused', which is correct everywhere the atom's absence really is the final word, but wrong here: the atom's absence is stale relative to a recovery mechanism it cannot see.
whichHalfIsWrong: The brief's absent is the wrong half for this specific case. draw.attrs.landUse is right -- the value is legitimately available from a second, independently-sourced derivation (owner-verified situs-address match against the same CAD roll), not a fabrication and not a re-derivation of the disabled prop_id join.
f27Read: Read, not chased (per dispatch instruction). F27 (parcel_gate_verdict passing landUseCode/owner rails on the same day the serve reports join-hold) is a THIRD, still-open question about whether the gate measures stored cells vs re-derives at request time, or passes vacuously. This lane's finding does not eliminate either F27 mechanism: parcel_gate_verdict is a parcel_record-cell gate, entirely orthogonal to the Tier-1 bake / land-use-fact-atom pair this lane traced. Reported as an open question, not resolved.

plannedFix.change: In buildR1Brief's land-use section, when root.provenance.landUseAddressRecovered === true, prefer baseFacts.landUse (the recovered value, matching what draw already reads) over the atom, regardless of the atom's state. Every other absent/refused/present shape is unchanged -- narrowly scoped to the one evidenced signal, not a general downgrade of atom trust.
plannedFix.outOfScope: LANDUSE_JOIN_DISABLED_FIPS_SEED (untouched), the land-use-fact atom writer (lives outside legacy-design-tools per this repo's own grep -- not re-derived per dispatch instruction), smartcity-os/smartcity-dashboards (untouched).

falsifiersPreRegistered: If the fix makes brief and draw agree by deleting/nulling the draw value while the value was actually legitimate and sourced, that is removing a working rail -- REJECTED as a fix shape before writing any code.

If the fix makes brief and draw agree by softening the brief's absent to something weaker (e.g. always trusting baked value over the atom), that converts a real finding (join-hold) into a label for every OTHER case too -- REJECTED; the fix must be scoped to exactly the address-recovered signal.

A fixture that passes both before and after the change does not test the disagreement -- the fixture must be run against the pre-fix code (via git stash of the fix commit alone) and shown to fail there, then pass after.

This is internal consistency within one payload (our own doctrine's warning: it looks meaning-shaped and may not be). The second, independent derivation this lane found is buildTier1Payload's own owner-gated situs-address join against a named, real CAD drop (hays_20260826_certified) -- named explicitly rather than asserted; if that provenance did not check out, the recovered value would have to be treated as no more independent than the atom, and the fix would not be justified.
